name: PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk
summary: PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production of animal feed in Indonesia. The company operates through Feedmill, Breeder, Broiler, and Food and Poultry Processing segments. It is also involved in the parent stock and day old chicken farm; broiler chicken farm; processing and preserving of meat; providing of food and beverages; and duck farm and slaughterhouse with packaging of poultry meat. It provides its products under the SunnyGold brand name. PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Malindo Feedmill Tbk operates as a subsidiary of Dragon Amity Pte. Ltd.
